server_url.description: URL of the debug-me server to connect to (overrides default)

command.description: Custom command to run instead of the default login shell

control_window.description: Whether to open a separate control window for session management and chat

server_mode.description: Run debug-me as a server instead of a client

server_logdir.description: Directory where the server logs sessions (used only in server mode)

server_port.description: TCP port the server listens on (used only in server mode)

from_email.description: Email address used as sender for session log emails (used only in server mode)

delete_old_logs.description: Delete log files after the session ends (used only in server mode)
